in_the_box.source_title: Supplementary instructions for X1C and X1C combo accessories in the box
in_the_box.locator: Accessories table, rows 1–14 and 16 (NO. / Descriptions / Marks); intro sentence
in_the_box.quote: The X1C combo package comes with screen, spool holder, filament, spare hotend, 2 nozzle wiping pads, power cord, unclogging pin tool, 4*6PIN cable, PTFE tube, screw pack for scraper
in_the_box.note: This is a refurbished unit; its page says every official refurbished product is "Repackaged with all the original accessories — manual, cables, and box." The page sells one version (X1C Combo), so row 15 (X1C: "PLA Basic 250g") is left out and rows 3–5 ("For the X1C combo only") are kept. Table rows in order, as written. The wiki adds: "Please note that the products you receive may undergo material changes and version iterations." The intro sentence names items with no table row (screen, power cord, PTFE tube, screw packs for the scraper and spool holder, the lidar quick label, quick start guide, disclaimers, warranty leaflet); they are listed last with section "Intro sentence". It also gives counts the table does not: "2 scrapers" and "2 nozzle wiping pads" are written as qty 2 on the table rows for the same items (row 9 Bambu scraper, row 14 Nozzle wiper); "5 lubricant grease" names no unit, so row 8 keeps an empty qty. The table does not list the printer, the AMS or the accessory box itself; the store box list does ("Bambu Lab X1C", "Bambu Lab AMS", "Accessory Box", "Spare Filament Cutter (x2)", "Bambu Bus Cable-6Pin(510mm)", "Bambu Bus Cable-4Pin(260mm)").

notes: The store link "Download X1C TDS" points to https://public-cdn.bambulab.com/store/X1-Carbon%20tech%20specs.pdf. It is not cached (the host answered 403 to robots.txt and was not contacted again) and its host is not an allowed document host, so it is not listed under documents. The X1C spec sheet was therefore not read: every spec here rests on the store page (official_page) and the box wiki, and not_published is left empty, because a key missing from the page and the box list is not evidence that the manufacturer does not publish it.

The page sells one version, X1C Combo. The table's X1C-only segment ("Package size 480 × 480 × 535 mm³", "Gross weight 18kg") is not written: no version value of this page matches it. The package writes that box at product scope (package.length/width/height 480/480/535, us_110v) and the two gross weights as one string at product scope (shipment.gross_weight "18000 / 22300 g", us_110v); the curated file cannot replace those page rows (same rank).
Page facts with no registry key, not written: "7μm lidar resolution", "Spaghetti failure detection", "AI inspected first layer", "Vibration Compensation & Extrusion Compensation", "extra cooling".

The "Learn more" link to bambulab.com/en/x1 ("Full advanced features of X1C 3D printers") was not read (bambulab.com is behind a bot challenge, §1 row 7). The wiki article linked from the table footnotes (https://wiki.bambulab.com/en/knowledge-sharing/print-volume-limitations) is not cached and was not read; the package already lists it as a document.
